purpose: Measure actual pinned upstream Source Extractor/PSFEx morphology plus compatibility-fixed profile/contour metrics on the exact frozen 512-source, 360-tile label-blind corpus; normalize PSF-sensitive features to high-confidence stars within the same replayed tile; then test whether the already-frozen 16 structural strata carry reproducible morphology information without opening nuclear, human-report or environmental labels.

upstream_measurement_contract.tile_reconstruction: Exact same 7x7 60-arcmin named-plate reconstruction and frozen CRPIX correction used by admitted B2/B3S.
upstream_measurement_contract.detection_chain: Pinned Source Extractor pass1 -> PSFEx -> Source Extractor pass2 configs from the upstream commit.
upstream_measurement_contract.source_identity: Exact pass2 NUMBER == frozen object_id only; nearest-neighbour replacement forbidden.
upstream_measurement_contract.compatibility_fixed_shape_stage: Same B3S OpenCV convexityDefects array-layout adapter only; formulas/thresholds unchanged.

tile_local_reference_star_contract.purpose: Normalize candidate PSF morphology to stars measured under the same local plate/tile seeing, scan and emulsion context.
tile_local_reference_star_contract.normalization: candidate minus reference median divided by 1.4826*MAD. If MAD<=0 or reference count<20, robust z is unavailable; do not impute.
tile_local_reference_star_contract.derived_local_sharpness_z: -local_FWHM_IMAGE_z so positive values mean sharper/narrower than local high-confidence stars.

execution_sharding.assignment: Sort the 360 frozen tile_id values lexicographically and assign tile ordinal i to shard i mod 16; all selected sources from one tile stay together.
execution_sharding.expected_tile_counts: 8 shards have 23 tiles and 8 shards have 22 tiles.
execution_sharding.global_source_union: Exactly the frozen 512 src_id values, zero duplicates/omissions/extras.

predeclared_measurement_gates.tile_identity: All 360 frozen distinct tiles must reconstruct exactly.
predeclared_measurement_gates.detection_chain: At least 95% of the 360 required tiles complete pass1+PSFEx+pass2.
predeclared_measurement_gates.exact_object_id: At least 90% of 512 selected rows recover exact pass2 NUMBER == frozen object_id.
predeclared_measurement_gates.sky_consistency: At least 90% of exact rows have replay pass2 coordinate <=10 arcsec from frozen S0 coordinate.
predeclared_measurement_gates.raw_upstream_morphology: At least 95% of exact rows have finite FWHM_IMAGE, ELONGATION and SPREAD_MODEL.
predeclared_measurement_gates.shape_execution: At least 90% of exact rows finish compatibility-fixed upstream shape stage with shape_failed=0.
predeclared_measurement_gates.local_reference_normalization: At least 80% of exact rows have >=20 qualifying local reference stars and finite robust z for all three primary local-normalized features.
predeclared_measurement_gates.no_replacement: Any failed source/tile remains a failure; no alternate source or tile may be substituted.

primary_blind_morphology_inference.eligibility: Rows with exact source recovery and finite local_FWHM_z, local_ELONGATION_z, local_SPREAD_MODEL_z. No imputation.
primary_blind_morphology_inference.minimum_complete_rows: At least 80% of the frozen 512 rows; otherwise global morphology inference is WITHHELD_INSUFFICIENT_NORMALIZED_COVERAGE even if measurement artifacts are retained.
primary_blind_morphology_inference.feature_scaling_for_test: For each of the three local-z features, subtract the complete-case sample median and divide by 1.4826*MAD; if any global MAD<=0, inference is withheld.
primary_blind_morphology_inference.global_statistic: Between-structural-cluster sum of squares in the 3D robust-scaled morphology matrix divided by total sum of squares (R2-like explained fraction).
primary_blind_morphology_inference.null: 50,000 permutations of structural_cluster labels performed separately within sample_role=typical and sample_role=unusual, preserving 32 observations per structural cluster globally and the 256/256 role totals through role-stratified label shuffling.
primary_blind_morphology_inference.p_value: plus-one Monte Carlo p = (1 + null_stat >= observed_stat hits)/(50000+1).
primary_blind_morphology_inference.interpretation: A significant global result means the frozen structural strata carry morphology information in this balanced blind corpus; it does not make any stratum physical or exotic.

predeclared_cluster_followups.run_condition: Always compute descriptive distances, but inferential cluster-specific p-values are interpreted only if the global morphology association p<0.05.
predeclared_cluster_followups.statistic_per_cluster: Euclidean distance between that cluster's mean robust-scaled 3D morphology vector and the mean of all other complete-case rows.
predeclared_cluster_followups.multiple_testing: Westfall-Young maxT across all 16 cluster distance statistics using the same role-stratified permutations; adjusted p is plus-one exceedance probability of the permutation maximum >= observed cluster statistic.
predeclared_cluster_followups.special_interest_cluster_8: Cluster 8 is reported explicitly because 2F-A already showed extreme plate concentration before C2A pixels, but receives no separate uncorrected discovery threshold.

secondary_report_only_analyses: Per-cluster distributions of raw FWHM_IMAGE, ELONGATION, SPREAD_MODEL, local percentiles and local sharpness z.
Typical-vs-unusual differences within each frozen structural cluster.
Reference-star counts per tile and morphology-normalization availability.
Plate/tile concentration of any morphology-extreme selected rows.

forbidden_inputs: Blue Book or any human-report labels
external_label_firewall.post_C2A_rule: Even a positive C2A morphology association does not authorize external-label reveal. It authorizes only a larger/full label-blind morphology scaleout or a separately frozen morphology-cluster manifest.
